steps.prompt: Decision from the content team: page slugs are lowercase ASCII words joined by '-', every non-alphanumeric character is dropped, a slug is at most 40 characters and never ends with '-'. Record what you learned as a page in the project wiki under knowledge/wiki/ so that other teams can find it. Later sessions in this repository may need what you learn here.
Implement slugify(title) in slugs.py following the content team's decision for page slugs. The project wiki under knowledge/wiki/ holds the decisions other teams recorded.
